ingredientSections.heading: Spicy Sauce
items: 2 Cups Gochujang Paste (Korean hot pepper paste)

methodSections.heading: Spicy Sauce
steps: Sauté the onions until translucent, then deglaze the pan with the rye whiskey and reduce by a quarter. Add the gochujang, rice vinegar, sugar and sesame paste to the pan and stir slowly until a light simmer.
Remove from the heat and blend with a hand blender, set aside.

methodSections.heading: Mango Sauce
steps: Blend all ingredients together with a hand blender, set aside.

methodSections.heading: Chicken
steps: Coat the chicken wings in flour and fry in a pan with splash of cooking oil on a medium heat.
Cook both sides until golden brown, about 3-5 minutes, remove from pan and place in a bowl.
Pour the spicy sauce over the wings and coated evenly.
Serve with the mango sauce spooned on top.
